{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|What seven sectors this refers to is a mystery to me since I've chased his stolen Star Galleon Robber Baron and Incom corsairs from the Colonies to the Outer Rim and back.|Rufaan Tigellinus|<ref name="Underworld Appendix: Swoops, Spice, and Wretched Rogues">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/89/indexp3.html|text=Underworld Appendix: Swoops, Spice, and Wretched Rogues|int=Underworld Appendix: Swoops, Spice, and Wretched Rogues}}</ref>}}
The [[Poss'Nomin]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Reginald Barkbone]] was the so-called [[Reginald Barkbone|Scourge]] of the '''Seven Sectors''' during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Rufaan Tigellinus]], tasked with Barkbone's apprehension, was unaware of what these seven sectors were.
